description: Place a perpetual-futures order. ALWAYS call with dry_run=true first to preview the exact request, then repeat with dry_run=false to execute. symbol must be uppercase (e.g. PERP_ETH_USDC). type is LIMIT, MARKET, IOC, FOK or POST_ONLY and is required for BUY/SELL orders. price is required for LIMIT, IOC, FOK and POST_ONLY. Short form: side=BID (market buy) or ASK (market sell), with no type or price. For Orderly Predict rounds use predict_buy/predict_sell instead. Set client_order_id to make retries idempotent. Returns the order object, including order_id.

dry_run.description: Print the request payload without signing or sending it

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

price.description: Order price (required for LIMIT, IOC, FOK, POST_ONLY)

reduce_only.description: Reduce-only order (can only reduce existing position, not open new)

side.description: side One of: BUY, SELL, BID, ASK.

type.description: Order type (omitted for the short BID/ASK form) One of: LIMIT, MARKET, IOC, FOK, POST_ONLY.

name: order_place
title: Place a perpetual order
